purpose: Define how SEIS work should move from local intent to GitHub-visible progress without confusing source quality, publication, and deployment state.

branch.protectedAssumption: Main branch remains sacred; publish claims require an authenticated UIXAppTTR push.

cadence.label: Intent capture
cadence.qualityGate: Scope is small enough to review and rollback.
cadence.githubSignal: Issue, commit note, or traceable doc explains why the work exists.

cadence.label: Source shaping
cadence.qualityGate: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, and docs stay modular and dependency-light.
cadence.githubSignal: Changed files are readable in a focused diff before release refresh.

cadence.label: Local verification
cadence.qualityGate: Run proportional checks that match the changed surface.
cadence.githubSignal: Commit message and PR body list exact checks and any environment limits.

cadence.label: GitHub publication
cadence.qualityGate: Clean worktree, expected branch, upstream, remote, and GitHub authentication are confirmed.
cadence.githubSignal: Remote shipment is claimed only after the authenticated push exists.

readinessSignals.label: Branch honesty
readinessSignals.expectation: UIXAppTTR remains the active GitHub development branch.

readinessSignals.label: Workspace integrity
readinessSignals.expectation: The web shell, data, marketplace, motion, and release sync checks remain coherent.

readinessSignals.label: Publish preflight
readinessSignals.expectation: GitHub shipment stays blocked until remote and authentication checks are real.

rollbackRules: Prefer one small reversible commit over broad unreviewable imports.
Refresh release/web only when the visible web surface changes.
Do not bulk-import archives, nested Git directories, personal media, or symlink mirrors.
Separate GitHub publication from live server deployment in every status statement.
